title: US-short §10 field registry governance (batch-1 capstone) — const-pins the per-field registry record schema, the operation_impact levels, the core-field classes + impact targets, the evidence claim types + traceback kinds, the no-dangling policy, and the pre-generation checks
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract (capstone — consumes all output surfaces + governance). Freezes §10 machine-enforced no-dangling + evidence-traceback + field registry: the per-field registry record schema (field_id … lifecycle_item_id, 10 keys, the last linking each field to the §13.1 lifecycle calibration registry); the operation_impact levels (硬否决/降仓/调信心/仅标签); the core-field classes that MUST hit ≥1 impact target (final_action/action_rank/position_size/price/action_confidence/risk_tags) else become shadow_record or be dropped; the evidence claim types that must each trace to a provider row / SEC filing / source_id (untraceable ⟹ never emitted as an operation impact); the forward no-dangling policy (compute-without-landing → report invalid; an advisory/shadow explanatory label is a valid landing); and the pre-generation checks whose failure makes the report not clean. draft-07 cannot express: byte-faithfulness of every set to §10, provenance, impact targets ⊆ action_table where applicable, and lifecycle_item_id presence — enforced in tests.

registry_record_fields.description: §10 完整字段 registry — per-field record keys, byte-faithful (lifecycle_item_id links to §13.1).

operation_impact_levels.description: §10 影响强度 levels (硬否决/降仓/调信心/仅标签), byte-faithful.

core_field_classes.description: §10 核心字段 classes that MUST hit ≥1 impact target (else shadow_record/drop), byte-faithful.

impact_targets.description: §10 the impact targets a core field must affect at least one of, byte-faithful.

evidence_claim_types.description: §10 claim types that must each trace to evidence, byte-faithful.

evidence_ref_kinds.description: §10 evidence reference kinds (provider row / SEC filing / source_id), byte-faithful.

no_dangling_policy.description: §10 正向 no-dangling — compute-without-landing → report invalid; advisory/shadow label is a valid landing; core field must hit an impact target or become shadow_record / be dropped.

evidence_traceback_policy.description: §10 反向证据反查 — every claim must trace; untraceable ⟹ never emitted as an operation impact.

pre_generation_checks.description: §10 报告生成前必检 — failure ⟹ report not clean.
